t: The PK1EURDLF Master Lock Elite 45mm laminated padlock, with 38mm internal shackle height, provides robust security for demanding applications. This heavy-duty outdoor padlock is ideal for securing gates, sheds, and trailers, offering reliable protection for trade professionals. It features a 8mm thick boron-hardened steel shackle with CutGuard technology, resisting bolt cutters and brute force attacks. The improved keyway minimizes wear and delivers smoother operation. A dual ball-bearing locking mechanism defends against prying and hammering, while a 5-pin cylinder enhances pick resistance. Constructed from laminated steel covered in corrosion resistant aluminium, with a nickel-plated shackle and rubber bumper, it ensures all-weather corrosion resistance and durability, making it a dependable choice for various security needs.
b: CutGuard Technology & Anti-Rotation Shackle Resists Bolt Cutters
